caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object shaped like a rocking horse. The main body consists of a curved, boat-like base made from light brown wood with visible wood grain patterns and a knot. Attached to the base is a small seat with straight sides and a rounded backrest, positioned at the center of the structure. At the front, a carved horse's head rises vertically, also in the same light brown wood, with simple features depicting the head and ears. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or details present.
title: Child's Rocking Chair
